title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the package door save refusal and the origin-gated removal verdict out of protocol.ts into protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts (#25467 cut 13)
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 13 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–12 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797 and #25939. The claim is `6409240079`; the scope is the cut 13 proposal of the cut 12 report (`6408535757`), as the server seat approved it in its dispatch order, **narrowed by one member** (below).

Two `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` (#23050 shape B): the package door's save refusal `refusePackagedBaseOverride` and the origin-gated removal verdict `originGatedRemovalRefusal`. `protocol.ts` loses 61 net lines (29,681 to 29,620). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

## The scope narrowed: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval` stays in the class

The proposal (my cut 12 report) named three members and said none reads a private-static member. That reading was wrong for one of them: it grepped the one-line spelling `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.NAME`, and `refusePackagedBaseRemoval` breaks that spelling across two lines (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` then `.mergesOverlayAtRead(request.type)`). `mergesOverlayAtRead` is `private static`, and the Release's stay list keeps the private-static readers in the class, which this order's rulings hold. So `refusePackagedBaseRemoval` stays, unedited, and the re-measure below walks the AST (a property access on the class identifier), not the text. The two members that move read no static member at all.

**Does `packagedBaseRefusal` ride along?** No. It is not a small private helper: it is a public member (the `/automation` domain of `@objectstack/runtime` calls it), it reads the private static `isPackagedBaseRefusal`, and it calls `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, which stays. It stays in the class and is handed to the moved `originGatedRemovalRefusal` as a closure.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread, restarted from `main` after cut 12 merged. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `ed0ca2d57` and the pin commit `1c09db420`, both on `main` `7a04ba288d` (cut 12's merge `efe35983f8` and #25935 are in its history), and the merge of `main` `59d9181ed` (`b1ac1d8a9`). That merge brought six commits, none of which touches `packages/metadata-protocol/` (the package's `src/` tree is `761912e9` at both ends of the range).

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** Measured just before this PR was opened: of the 14 open PRs, one touches `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`: #25941 edits `metadata-diagnostics.ts` and adds its memo test, disjoint from `protocol.ts`. #25826 is no longer open. The release PR #25640's file list could not be paged through this container's proxy; at cut 11 it touched only the package's `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json`. No open PR edits `protocol.ts`.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refusePackagedBaseOverride` | `:16370` | private | 136 |
| `originGatedRemovalRefusal` | `:16534` | private | 43 |

(`refusePackagedBaseOverride`'s 72 body lines are mostly its record comment; comments are not AST tokens, and the comparison below checks them as text.)

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–12 apply it)

- **The class keeps every member** with its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body is now one host literal plus a `.call`, marked `[#25467 cut 13]`.
- **Typing.** `PackagedBaseRefusalHost` types every member as the class member itself (an indexed access on `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the members its body reads. Each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of `typeof fn`. No cast, no generic member (so the plain `.call` spelling), and no member changes visibility.
- **Members read, measured.** `refusePackagedBaseOverride` reads `isSealedManagedItem` and `isWritablePackage`; `originGatedRemovalRefusal` reads `packagedBaseRefusal`. Each goes as a closure on the protocol. No field is read, so there is no getter.
- **Every other caller still calls the class method**: `saveMetaItem` and `packagedBaseRefusal` call `refusePackagedBaseOverride`; `deleteMetaItem` calls `originGatedRemovalRefusal`.

## Module-level declarations, by reader

- **None gains `export`, none moves.** The bodies read no module-level declaration of `protocol.ts`. They read `SysMetadataRepository` (its static `readOnlyBaseOverrideError`), `managedItemSealedSentence` and `isOriginGatedType`, which the new module imports from where `protocol.ts` imports them (`./sys-metadata-repository.js`, `./packaged-base-regime.js`). The new module's only import from `protocol.js` is a type import, so it adds no runtime cycle.
- **Imports in `protocol.ts`.** One name loses its last reader and is dropped: `isOriginGatedType` from `./packaged-base-regime.js` (at base: the import, the body of `originGatedRemovalRefusal`, and a `{@link}` in its docblock, which stays as prose). The one new statement is the import of the new module.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`, sorted-union identity, measured first. Base `7a04ba288d` and head were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree (the closure built at head by a full `pnpm build`, 119/119, then the package's `src/` swapped tree-only to base for the base build and restored from `HEAD` under a trap; `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean and all three touched blobs equal to `HEAD`'s after). Measured twice: on the pre-merge tree (base `7a04ba288d`, head `1c09db420`) and after the merge (merged base, head `b1ac1d8a9`, closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 119/119); the readings below hold for both.

- **Raw sha256**: `08914e65f936a2b031c3f3f215481a97f53d132eefd869e4f42d928947ebe173` at base and at head, on both `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`, 775,874 bytes each. **Raw identity holds**, so sorted-union identity holds too. Both members stay `private NAME;` lines.
- **Normalised sha256**: `46ccd7e5c4db673652513d1801ec9c9f06bf34a0a7fb6ba97fb2531ef0cc544b` at both ends (80 string-literal union runs sorted; this series' cut 12 normaliser).
- **The two builds differ where they should**: `index.js` hashes `53d93de18be521db…` at base and `4d3c4c7364445db0…` at head; each of the two functions' `.call(host` sites occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
- **Positive control** on the head tree (on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap, hash equal to `HEAD`'s after): `private` dropped from `originGatedRemovalRefusal` and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `fec45eed6afc2fff…`, so the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head; the sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all four. Neither moved function nor the host type appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

- **Bodies, by AST token** (the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, JSDoc skipped, over parameters less the added `this`, return type and body): 179 tokens compared, **0 differ**. The parameter, return-type and body text, comments included, is also equal with whitespace collapsed, for both. Negative control: one changed token in `refusePackagedBaseOverride`'s body (`namedBase &&` to `namedBase ||`, on an in-memory copy) makes the check report `differ=1` on that member and 0 on the other.
- **Class side.** 300 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 298 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Each of the 2 stubs sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical (everything before the body's opening brace).
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** 240 of the 241 base statements other than the class are byte-identical, leading comments included. The other one is the `./packaged-base-regime.js` import, which loses `isOriginGatedType`. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +157 / −75 over 3 files, 232 changed lines (the order's estimate was 250–320 for three members; the narrowed cut is smaller). `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` has 140 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

Every test and script that reads `protocol.ts` by path, and every test file in `packages/` and `scripts/`, was grepped for the three proposed member names and the host name; so was `docs/qa/`, which cites methods by name.

- `protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts` (lines 9, 225, 231), `protocol.package-door-before-gates.test.ts` (line 7) and objectql `engine-security-catalog-package-door.test.ts` (line 13) name `refusePackagedBaseOverride` / `refusePackagedBaseRemoval` **in comments only**; none reads `protocol.ts` by path or asserts on the bodies' text. Verdict: no edit owed; all three pass at head (see Verification).
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json` cites `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts#refusePackagedBaseOverride` as an anchor (line 1517) and in prose (line 1459). The method keeps its name in `protocol.ts`, and `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` judges it: OK, 1 anchored file in the change set, 29 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- No other hit outside `CHANGELOG.md` entries.
- **Bracketed-refusal pin** (`PRODUCERS`): `refusePackagedBaseOverride`'s one `new Error(` moves with its body, so the new module gets a row, `'protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts': 1`, the module's own count (the order's "two" counted the one in `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, which stays). `protocol.ts` goes from 72 to 71 such sites, still above its floor of 5. Control: with that throw changed to `new TypeError(` (on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap, hash equal to `HEAD`'s after; on-disk counts read first: 0 `new Error(`, 1 `new TypeError(`), the new row fails with "protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts no longer constructs errors here — this pin is scanning the wrong file: expected 0 to be greater than or equal to 1" (1 failed, 14 passed); restored, 15/15 pass.
- **ADR anchors and decision letters.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends: 85 anchored files, 58,860 citations, files 8,259 → 8,260, and **1,847 → 1,843** decision-letter citations. The four that leave the anchored file are comments in `refusePackagedBaseOverride`'s body: three `ADR-0131 D6` and one `ADR-0070 D1`. The `protocol.ts` anchor entry's four paragraphs (ADR-0029 D9.8/D9.9 object hydration, ADR-0119 atomic batches, ADR-0005 appendix (c) view storage, ADR-0126 §2 / §3 flow regime) do not describe the package door, so the new module gets no entry (disclosure only, as cuts 8 and 12 disclosed theirs). `ADR-0005`, which the moved comments also cite, stays referenced from `protocol.ts` (the gate's "every governing ADR still referenced" holds).
- **Durability checker**: `check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output, and its `--list` is identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped (159 lines): the moved bodies hold no `try`/`catch`.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends. The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (14083 → 14085, 14108 → 14110). `productionFiles` is 3,707 at base and 3,709 at head: +1 is the new file, +1 is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, which the spec build writes in the head tree and the clean base tree had not built.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `7a04ba288d`.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h`: 0 of 3 paths hit the register, NOT governed; 232 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 before and after the merge. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` (the whole touched package; it has no `lint` script, these are the root `lint` script's flags) exits 0, no output.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status (vitest `--maxWorkers=2`, JSON reporter, each run under the shared verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0` both legs), on the pre-merge tree (the merge changed no file of the package):
  - Base `7a04ba288d`: 21,537 tests (21,518 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 267 files.
  - Head `1c09db420`: 21,538 tests (21,519 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 267 files.
  - None lost, none changed status, one added: the new `PRODUCERS` row's case. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `7a04ba288d` (the new module removed from the tree) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
- **Cross-package pin named in prose.** objectql `engine-security-catalog-package-door.test.ts` at head `b1ac1d8a9`, under the verify lock: 1 file, 18/18 passed, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The two metadata-protocol pins named above ran inside the package suite and pass at both ends.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 59 gates on 3 changed paths, the same list before and after the merge; all 59 exit 0 on the merged tree `b1ac1d8a9`, after the full `pnpm build` and with the plugin-teardown fixture commit fetched first. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 59 derived, 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `refusePackagedBaseRemoval` and `refusePackagedBaseOverride` now live in two files, though their docblocks describe them as twins (one predicate, `isSealedManagedItem`). The removal twin can follow only once private-static readers can move (the stay list's reason); until then the class docblocks, which did not move, still name each other with `{@link}`.
- The proposal's static-read screen was a text grep and missed a two-line spelling; this cut's screen walks the AST. The cut 14 proposal in the report was screened the same way.

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 12: public members whose return type is inferred, the bodies kept by a reader (`probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`), and the private-static readers (now named among them: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval` and `packagedBaseRefusal`, besides `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`) stay in `protocol.ts`.
